nodes.description: Comprehensive project README with verifiable state table. SPA Vue 3 with public and authenticated routes. Public surface: only GET /api/public/graph/bootstrap and GET /api/public/graph/sensors/{sensor}/series (filtered by public_monitoring_enabled). Ingestion: raw-first with raw_sensor_events + raw_event_outboxes in one transaction. Debezium captures binlog, consumers normalize and deliver domain events. Auth: Sanctum, API key, ingestion token, admin middleware. Domain model: LAB→DEVICE→SENSOR→SENSOR_READING, ALERT_RULE, ALERT, RAW_SENSOR_EVENT, RAW_EVENT_OUTBOX, DOMAIN_EVENT_OUTBOX. Alert cycle: reading → AlertService evaluates rules → alert + domain outbox → CDC → domain:consume → broadcasting. Complete API inventory with access boundaries.
nodes.rationale: The most up-to-date verified-state document. Contains the complete API inventory, domain model, access boundaries, Docker Compose instructions, and diagnostic procedures. Supersedes DOCUMENTACION_PROYECTO.md for runtime truth.
